summary: Frontend E2E testing of Contactless QR/Code payment (Phase D) — admin config, driver QR generation, client SB Pay payment with commission split and cashback, payee credit. All critical flows passing.

integration_issues.flow: Idempotency reload on /pay/<id> by original payer
integration_issues.issue: Spec says reload should show 'pay-unavailable' (no longer pending). For the original payer, the page instead shows 'pay-success' (paid state) with amount and link to wallet. Marked OPTIONAL in spec. Behavior is reasonable but not matching exact spec testid expectations.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide whether reloading /pay/<id> as the original payer (already-paid) should show 'pay-unavailable' (per spec) or 'pay-success' (current). Both are reasonable; current behavior is informative.

seed_data_creation: Driver QR code generated (code 219247) and consumed via SB Pay payment cl_3409e00b8a37 for 12€ from test2@example.com to jean.dupont. Wallet of client decreased 200→188.24 (12€ debit + 0.24€ cashback). Driver credited +10.80€ (net of 10% commission).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D contactless QR/code payment fully verified on frontend. End-to-end SB Pay path works including: admin config toast 'Paiement sans contact mis à jour' on commission update, /encaisser QR generation showing amount/QR/code/countdown, /pay code-entry resolving to /pay/<id>, default SB Pay method selection, pay-confirm leads to pay-success, client wallet shows 'Paiement sans contact' debit (-12€) plus 'Cashback paiement sans contact' (+0.24€), driver wallet shows 'Encaissement sans contact #...' with +10.80€ (12 - 10% commission). Only optional idempotency note: reloading /pay/<id> as the original payer shows pay-success not pay-unavailable.
